jobs.title: Lead Java Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking an energetic and highly skilled Lead Java Developer to spearhead the design, development, and implementation of complex backend systems. In this pivotal role, you will lead a talented team of software engineers, driving innovative solutions that enhance system scalability, performance, and reliability. Your expertise in Java and related technologies will be instrumental in building robust distributed systems and modern web applications. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy mentoring others, and are passionate about delivering high-quality software, this opportunity is perfect for you!

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and maintenance of backend systems using Java, ensuring adherence to best practices in software engineering and system design.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and translate them into scalable architecture solutions.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including planning, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
* Drive the adoption of Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban to promote efficient project delivery.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs, web services (SOAP), and microservices architectures to facilitate seamless integration across platforms.
* Ensure system scalability, performance optimization, and security by applying principles of distributed computing and cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).
* Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and promote best practices in version control (GitHub, TFS), unit testing, CI/CD pipelines, and debugging techniques.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience as a Lead Java Developer or similar senior role with a strong portfolio of enterprise-level applications.
* Extensive knowledge of Java frameworks such as Hibernate, Spring Boot (including ASP.NET Core for cross-platform development), and MVC architecture.
* Proficiency in front-end development using React, Angul

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer(Distributed Systems)
jobs.description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About the Team**

Data Platform and Observability Engineering builds the platforms Workday teams use to turn data into reliable, governed products. We sit at the intersection of distributed systems, analytics engineering, and platform operations.
  
  
This team is building a highly scalable data-product platform: compute, storage, catalog, orchestration, access control, and the workflows teams use to develop, test, and operate data products and marts. We treat the platform as a product, reusable capabilities, clear contracts, and a path from model to query to visualization, so engineering and analytics teams can own what they build without each standing up a stack of their own.
